# Character Career Log

This log chronicles out-of-session missions, downtime decisions, Karma expenditures, and financial ledgers.

*This log contains spoilers! Please do not read if you haven't played the sessions yet!*
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
from sr6core.log_engine import (
    init_character, mission, contact, add_rep, add_sprite,
    get_active_sprites, state, assign, modifier, complex_form,
    sprite_power, work_for_the_people, work_for_the_man, bribe,
    lifestyle, learn_complex_form, inc, inc_many, print_contacts_summary
)

init_character("reiko")

# Initial baseline values (fallback if evaluating character_log independently)
if "Nuyen" not in state or state.get("Nuyen", 0) == 0:
    assign("Nuyen", 90000) # 90,000¥ Starting Chargen Resources
    assign("Lifetime_Nuyen", 90000)
if "Karma" not in state or state.get("Karma", 0) == 0:
    assign("Karma", 1)
    assign("Lifetime_Karma", 1)
assign("Submersion_Grade", 2) # Submersion Grade at Chargen
assign("Resonance", 6)
assign("Heat", 0)
assign("Current_Mission", 0)

Missions = state["Missions"]
Reputation = state["Reputation"]
Sprites = state["Sprites"]
Contacts = state["Contacts"]
Submersion_Grade = state["Submersion_Grade"]
```
